description:
about our brand and products

calm organics creates elevated home essentials for a cleaner, slower, more intentional way of living. our products are made for everyday rituals,  kitchen resets, food storage, sourdough routines, meal prep, home organization, and the small details that make a space feel calm and considered.

we design pieces that fit naturally into modern homes: non-toxic, functional, refined, and easy to share through lifestyle content.

what makes us different

calm organics is not built around random products. every piece is chosen to support a cleaner home, a more intentional routine, and a lifestyle people actually want to be part of.

our ambassador program is selective. we choose creators based on content quality, aesthetic, values, audience fit, and brand alignment, not just follower count. ambassadors are invited into the brand early, with access to launches, gifting opportunities, pr packages, and future collaborations as calm organics grows.

how ambassadors can earn

approved ambassadors earn commission on eligible sales made through their unique ambassador link or code. when your audience shops calm organics through your referral, you earn a percentage of the approved purchase.

as the brand grows, aligned ambassadors may also be considered for product gifting, launch campaigns, pr packages, unreleased products, ugc opportunities, and future paid collaborations.

how to promote us

share calm organics in a way that feels natural to your life and content. the strongest content shows our products inside real routines: kitchen resets, fridge organization, meal prep, sourdough storage, snack prep, clean home moments, motherhood, homemaking, pet care, and intentional living.

we value content that feels honest, refined, and organic, not forced, over-scripted, or overly salesy. show the product as part of the lifestyle your audience already trusts you for.
payout_period: commissions are reviewed and paid monthly after orders are confirmed, fulfilled, and outside the refund or cancellation window.

term_and_condition:
calm organics ambassador program terms

welcome to the calm organics ambassador program. we’re so glad you’re here.

these terms apply to all individuals approved to participate in the calm organics ambassador program. by applying for or participating in the program, you agree to follow these terms and represent calm organics in a way that is honest, aligned, and consistent with our brand values.

  1. application approval

the calm organics ambassador program is selective. we reserve the right to approve or decline any application at our discretion. approval is based on brand alignment, content quality, audience fit, values, and overall aesthetic.

submitting an application does not guarantee acceptance into the program.

  1. ambassador links and codes

approved ambassadors may receive a unique referral link, discount code, or both. these tools are used to track eligible purchases and assign commission.

ambassadors may share their link or code through approved channels such as instagram, tiktok, youtube, blogs, newsletters, websites, or other content platforms that align with calm organics.

ambassadors may not promote unauthorized discount codes, misleading offers, fake claims, or expired promotions.

if a customer uses more than one referral link, code, or promotion, commission tracking will be determined by the program’s tracking system and settings.

  1. commission and payments

ambassadors earn commission on eligible purchases made through their approved referral link or code.

commission is calculated based on the order subtotal and does not include taxes, shipping, refunds, discounts, chargebacks, or any other additional fees.

commission is only paid on completed, approved orders. refunded, canceled, fraudulent, or disputed orders are not eligible for payout.

ambassadors are responsible for providing accurate payment information. payout timing, payment method, and commission details may be shown inside the ambassador dashboard or communicated directly by calm organics.

we reserve the right to review referral activity before approving commission.

  1. content and brand representation

ambassadors agree to represent calm organics honestly and professionally. content should feel natural, tasteful, and aligned with the calm organics identity: cleaner living, intentional routines, elevated home essentials, and non-toxic lifestyle choices.

ambassadors may not make false, exaggerated, medical, or unsupported claims about calm organics products.

ambassadors should clearly disclose their relationship with calm organics when sharing affiliate links, discount codes, gifted products, sponsored content, or paid collaborations, in accordance with applicable advertising guidelines.

  1. content usage rights

by participating in the program, ambassadors understand that calm organics may request permission to use creator content for brand, ugc, organic social, website, email, or advertising purposes.

calm organics will not use ambassador content in paid advertising without permission. if we would like to use your content for paid ads, whitelisting, boosted posts, ugc campaigns, or other advertising placements, we will contact you for approval first.

if approved, usage terms may be discussed separately, including content format, placement, duration, compensation, and any additional rights needed.

  1. pr packages, gifting, and launches

select ambassadors may be considered for product gifting, pr packages, unreleased products, launch mailers, seasonal campaigns, or future paid collaborations.

gifting is not guaranteed and may depend on brand fit, campaign needs, content quality, location, product availability, and overall alignment with calm organics.

receiving a gifted product does not guarantee future gifts, paid work, or continued participation in the program.

  1. tracking and cookies

calm organics uses tracking links, codes, and cookies to attribute eligible purchases to ambassadors.

if a customer disables cookies, clears cookies, uses a different device, or does not complete a purchase within the tracking window, we may not be able to attribute the sale.

the cookie window and tracking details may be listed in the ambassador dashboard or registration page.

  1. prohibited activity

ambassadors may not use spam, misleading advertising, fake accounts, coupon abuse, unauthorized paid search bidding, brand impersonation, false scarcity, fake reviews, or any content that damages the reputation of calm organics.

ambassadors may not present themselves as employees, owners, or official representatives of calm organics unless given written permission.

we reserve the right to remove any ambassador from the program and void commission for activity that violates these terms or does not align with the brand.

  1. removal from the program

calm organics may remove an ambassador from the program at any time if we believe their content, conduct, promotional methods, or audience fit no longer align with the brand.

ambassadors may also request to leave the program by contacting ros@calmorganics.shop.

  1. updates to these terms

calm organics may update these terms from time to time. continued participation in the ambassador program means you accept the most current version of the terms.

questions

for ambassador questions, collaborations, or application support, contact our brand partnerships manager ros@calmorganics.shop.
